setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Song slot 1 holds the four-step phrase on channel 1 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) and slot 2 is a copy with channel 1 raised one octave. Song mode is Off, the tempo is 90 BPM, slot 1 is selected and playback is stopped. Song tasks > Tempo / feel is the screen that holds the song's one tempo, next to its swing and shuffle feel.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Close the menu. With slot 1 selected at (1,1), turn E1 to Song tasks, turn E2 to Tempo / feel and press K3. Turn E3 all the way down: Tempo reads 30, the lowest value.
steps.title: Turn Tempo down to 30

steps.caption: Press K3 to apply, then press Play (1,8) to hear the phrase at 30 BPM and press Play again to stop. Swing type stays Swing and Swing 0.
steps.title: Hear slot 1 at 30 BPM

steps.caption: Select slot 2 at (2,1), the copy that plays an octave higher, then turn E1 to Song tasks, E2 to Tempo / feel and press K3. It already reads 30: tempo belongs to the whole song, not to one slot.
steps.title: Slot 2 reads the same tempo

steps.caption: Press Play (1,8) and Stop to hear slot 2 at 30 BPM. With slot 2 selected, open Tempo / feel again, turn E3 all the way up: Tempo reads 300, the highest value. Press K3 to apply.
steps.title: Turn Tempo up to 300

steps.caption: Press Play (1,8) to hear slot 2 at 300 BPM, ten times as fast as before, then press Play again to stop.
steps.title: Hear slot 2 at 300 BPM

steps.caption: Select slot 1 at (1,1) and open Tempo / feel again. It reads 300, the value you set while slot 2 was selected.
steps.title: Slot 1 reads 300

steps.caption: Press Play (1,8) to hear slot 1 at 300 BPM and Stop. Open Tempo / feel on slot 1, turn E3 down to 30, then up 60 detents to 90, and press K3 to apply.
steps.title: Set Tempo back to 90

steps.caption: Press Play (1,8) to hear slot 1 at 90 BPM, the starting tempo, then press Play again to stop.
steps.title: Hear slot 1 at 90 BPM

steps.caption: Select slot 2 at (2,1) and open Tempo / feel. It reads 90 too: the tempo you set on any slot applies to every slot.
steps.title: Slot 2 follows to 90

title: Set Tempo and feel across Song slots
